summary: Tested all new E-ARMS features: new booking form fields, conditional Command HQ, family members, pending refunds PDF, settings license fee breakdown, monthly report page with PDF, dashboard Monthly Report button navigation. All features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings page uses Tailwind dynamic color classes (bg-${color}-50) which may not be purged correctly in production builds — consider using static class names instead
pdfUtils.js generateCheckoutReceipt uses rowStyles callback which is not a valid jspdf-autotable API — should use didParseCell (though it still generates PDF, the row highlighting may not work)
seed_data_creation: Created test booking BK20260402151757053B with service_type=Army, command_hq=Eastern Command, army_number, family_members
